chunks: And it is narrated: “When a woman reaches fifty years of age, she no longer sees redness, except if she is a woman from Quraysh.”

key_terms.الْمَرْأَةَ: the woman; the subject of the legal ruling
key_terms.بَلَغَتْ: reaches; attains the specified age threshold
key_terms.حُمْرَةً: redness; referring here to menstrual blood
key_terms.خَمْسِينَ: fifty; the age mentioned in the ruling
key_terms.سَنَةً: years; the unit of age in the report
key_terms.قُرَيْشٍ: Quraysh; the tribe for which an exception is mentioned

ai.seo_question: At what age is a woman considered to have reached menopause in this hadith, and what is the exception for women of Quraysh?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal marker concerning a woman's age and the cessation of menstrual blood. It notes an exception for a woman from Quraysh, indicating a specific juristic distinction in rulings related to menstruation and menopausal age.
